smokeSubset.description: Runs already-promoted managed local ESM, controlled HTTP/HTTPS facade shape, checked-in pure JavaScript dependency, and scoped advanced filesystem snippets without enabling high-risk desktop authority or live network I/O.

examples.title: managed local ESM loader migration
examples.outcome: Node's native ESM linker imports the local fixture.

examples.title: stable worker_threads migration
examples.outcome: Native worker_threads are enabled by default; the worker replies 42.

examples.title: controlled HTTP/HTTPS client migration
examples.outcome: Native http/https modules are available; this snippet only checks their shape.

examples.title: stable native Node network module migration
examples.outcome: Native http/https/net/tls/dns modules are available; dgram and http2 need the raw_network capability.

examples.title: scoped advanced fs migration
examples.outcome: FileHandle, fs.watch and fs/promises work inside Android file access.

examples.title: controlled WASI profile migration
examples.outcome: node:wasi is denied by decision (M13.6); the snippet prints the denial code. Pure WebAssembly is available.

examples.title: debug inspector profile migration
examples.outcome: The inspector needs an explicit Debug host request; without it the snippet prints the denial code.

examples.title: sanitized pure JavaScript npm dependency migration
examples.outcome: A checked-in pure JavaScript dependency loads through require(); registry installs happen in the host terminal.
